question: Let $A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ x & 5 & 6 \\ 7 & 8 & y \end{bmatrix}$. If $|A| = 0$ and $x = 4$, evaluate $y$.
explanation:
Since $|A|=0$.
$\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \\ 7 & 8 & y \end{vmatrix} = 0$
Expand along first row.
$1 \begin{vmatrix} 5 & 6 \\ 8 & y \end{vmatrix} - 2 \begin{vmatrix} 4 & 6 \\ 7 & y \end{vmatrix} + 3 \begin{vmatrix} 4 & 5 \\ 7 & 8 \end{vmatrix} = 0$
$1(5y-48) -2(4y-42) + 3(4*8-5*7)=0$
$= 5y-48 -8y+84 + 3(32-35)$
$= (5y-8y) + (-48+84) + 3(-3)$
$= -3y + 36 -9$
$= -3y + 27$
So $-3y + 27 = 0$
$y = 9$
